name: Snarlshield, wooden
source: Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 6, Gnomes of Golarion pg. 22
body:
Source Adventurer's Armory 2 pg. 6, Gnomes of Golarion pg. 22
Statistics
Cost 37 gp Weight 15 lbs.
Armor Bonus +2; Max Dex Bonus —; Armor Check Penalty -3
Arcane Spell Failure Chance 15%; Speed —/—
Description
The snarlshield is a heavy shield that features a dozen rods protruding from its surface. When used as a weapon to bash an opponent, a snarlshield has the disarm quality (Core Rulebook 144).
